reference_scan: Tracked non-upstream checkers, workflows, receipts and documents checked by exact path, current SHA-256, gzip decoded SHA-256 and context-resolved relative basename. Referenced and explicitly protected inputs retained. Unrelated basename collisions are not references.
scope: Unreferenced raw evidence, failed-attempt copies and superseded workflows. History is preserved; this reduces the active checkout, not the repository object history.

retained.note: Pinned workflows, failed copies and test documents remain in place.
